sources.ref: Qudelix app for Chrome 4.0.3.1 (Chrome extension phaodiidhofhdmfkjiacigibgikhfafn): the second protocol, its EQ groups and the 5K Plus's editor limits

meta.notes: What Qudelix's app for Chrome does with the devices on its second USB protocol, so far only the 5K Plus. Everything is as in qudelix-app except the handler and Q, which the app's editor takes up to 63 on this model instead of 15 (same 1/1024 grid). The EQ layout differs in size only: the user EQ has 10 bands on one channel, the headphone EQ 20 bands per channel and the all-band EQ of single-EQ mode 30 bands. The app also offers a choice of how the graphic EQ's Q is computed; the graphic EQ is not driven. The same presets: 0 to 21 built in, 22 to 41 the user's 20 memories; the app lists a memory only when it was stored with the EQ type (parametric or graphic) the EQ has now.
